usedFor: SuperSaaS holds appointments and users, and Conversion Chats messages the customer when “New Appointment” runs “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Appointment” in SuperSaaS, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A new booking gets a templated confirmation message.

watchOut: “Appointment Changes” also fires on changes and deletions, so a cancellation would run “Send Template Message” too.
